title: 8.57. Dassanenapahātabbaduka
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Nadassanena pahātabbaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nadassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
Nanadassanena pahātabbaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nanadassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … tīṇi.
Nadassanena pahātabbañca nanadassanena pahātabbañca dhammaṁ paṭicca nadassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Hetuyā pañca, ārammaṇe dve …pe… vipāke ekaṁ …pe… avigate pañca.
